title: Force‐Locking DNA Hairpin Probes for High‐Throughput and Cumulative Detection of Intercellular Molecular Tensions
source: Wiley: Angewandte Chemie International Edition: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Mechanical forces at cell‐cell junctions play essential roles in tissue organization, morphogenesis, and disease progression, yet their transient and low‐intensity nature makes detection challenging. Here, we introduce force‐locking integrator probe (FLIP)—a DNA‐based system that records cumulative molecular tension events over time. FLIP employs membrane‐anchored DNA hairpins as force sensors and fluorophore‐labeled locking strands that selectively hybridize upon hairpin unfolding, forming stable duplexes that preserve force history at the single‐cell level. By leveraging endocytosis‐driven uptake, FLIP converts membrane tension signals into whole‐cell fluorescence, extending detection beyond the short surface lifetime of lipid‐DNA probes. We demonstrate long‐term and high‐throughput measurement of integrin‐ and E‐cadherin‐mediated intercellular forces using fluorescence microscopy and flow cytometry across thousands of cells. FLIP reveals force‐dependent changes under cytoskeletal perturbation and supports ratiometric imaging for precise analysis. This platform enables robust mapping of cumulative intercellular forces, offering new opportunities to study mechanotransduction in collective cell behaviors and to accelerate the development of mechano‐active therapeutics.

title: Built-In Electric Fields and Ir-Cl Motifs at Heterointerfaces Enable Selective and Durable Seawater Electrolysis
source: RSC - Energy Environ. Sci. latest articles
abstract: Alkaline seawater electrolysis is fundamentally constrained by intrinsic trade-offs among oxygen evolution reaction (OER) activity, selectivity, and durability, arising from sluggish OER kinetics, parasitic chloride oxidation, and catalyst degradation. Here, we report an integrated interfacial design of an Ir/NiFe layered double hydroxide (Ir/NiFe LDH) heterostructure that unifies dual-pathway OER kinetic promotion with a chloride-sink effect at a heterointerface. Spontaneous interfacial charge transfer from metallic Ir to NiFe LDH establishes a built-in electric field, which regulates electronic structure of the Ni/Fe active centers and simultaneously activates both the adsorbate evolution mechanism and the lattice oxygen mechanism, thereby accelerating OER kinetics. Meanwhile, the coupled Ir domains serve as robust chloride sinks: Cl- preferentially coordinates to Ir sites to form stable Ir-Cl motifs, redirecting corrosive chloride species away from the NiFe OER active centers and suppressing chloride oxidation side reactions. Consequently, the catalyst delivers an ultralow overpotential of 201 mV at 10 mA cm-2 in alkaline natural seawater and sustains operation for over 5200 h at 500 mA cm-2 in a commercial electrolyzer with negligible voltage decay, achieving an energy efficiency of 71.2% and an electricity cost of US$0.944 kg-1 H2. This work resolves the long-standing activity-selectivity-durability trade-off in alkaline seawater electrolysis and provides a general interfacial engineering strategy for high-performance electrocatalysis in chemically competitive complex electrolytes.

title: The role of hydrogen in a global net-zero greenhouse gas emission plastics industry
source: Joule
abstract: Defossilizing plastics production relies on recycling combined with biomass and carbon capture and utilization (CCU), which requires clean hydrogen. However, the hydrogen demand from bio-based and CCU technologies is unknown. By applying prospective life cycle assessment, this study shows that achieving a net-zero greenhouse gas emissions global plastics industry by 2050 requires a 14-fold increase in hydrogen demand, totaling 126–145 Mt of hydrogen. Moreover, by combining bio-based and electricity-based hydrogen production, the plastics industry can balance multiple planetary boundaries.

abstract_zh: 脱化石塑料生产依赖于与生物质和碳捕获和利用（CCU）相结合的回收利用，这需要清洁的氢气。然而，生物基技术和 CCU 技术对氢气的需求尚不清楚。通过应用前瞻性生命周期评估，这项研究表明，到 2050 年实现全球塑料行业温室气体净零排放需要将氢气需求增加 14 倍，总计 126-145 公吨氢气。此外，通过结合生物基和电力制氢，塑料工业可以平衡多个地球边界。

title: Contact loss in all-solid-state Li-ion batteries via deposition of impurities
source: Joule
abstract: Interfacial contact loss in solid-state batteries is often attributed to the formation of voids in pristine lithium (Li) metal at the Li-solid electrolyte interface. We show that insulating impurities within the Li anode accumulate at the interface during stripping and create a porous, mechanically stable layer that blocks the flux of Li into the electrolyte.
title_zh: 全固态锂离子电池中杂质沉积导致的接触损耗
abstract_zh: 固态电池中的界面接触损耗通常归因于原始锂（Li）金属在锂-固体电解质界面处形成的空隙。我们发现，锂阳极内的绝缘杂质在剥离过程中积聚在界面处，并形成多孔、机械稳定的层，阻止锂流入电解质。

title: Controlling the deposition of Li2O2 for high-performance lithium-oxygen batteries
source: Matter
abstract: Light-assisted Li-O2 batteries remain limited by inefficient coupling between photogenerated carriers and Li2O2 chemistry. Here, we develop fluorine-substituted graphdiyne (FGDY) as a photo-responsive cathode, with light-induced intramolecular charge redistribution within the sp–sp2 carbon framework, it regulates the adsorption of Li+ and oxygen intermediates, enabling membrane-like Li2O2 growth along the fibrous FGDY network rather than insulating disk-like crystals. This pathway-selective regulation enhances reaction reversibility, suppresses parasitic reactions, and delivers a Li-O2 battery with 97.5% round-trip efficiency under illumination.
title_zh: 控制高性能锂氧电池中Li2O2的沉积
abstract_zh: 光辅助Li-O2电池仍然受到光生载流子和Li2O2化学之间低效耦合的限制。在这里，我们开发了氟取代石墨二炔（FGDY）作为光响应阴极，在sp-sp2碳框架内具有光诱导的分子内电荷重新分布，它调节Li +和氧中间体的吸附，使膜状Li2O2沿着纤维状FGDY网络生长，而不是绝缘盘状晶体。这种路径选择性调节增强了反应的可逆性，抑制了寄生反应，并提供了光照下往返效率为 97.5% 的 Li-O2 电池。

title: Heterogeneous viral-host response at single-cell resolution and viral adaptive mutational atlas in birds and mammals upon H5 influenza virus infection
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: H5 highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses (HPAIVs) are prevalent in birds, causing infection in over 60 mammalian species worldwide. However, species-specific viral-host response at the single-cell level and within-host evolution upon H5-HPAIV infection are poorly understood. Here, by integrating spatial transcriptomics and single-cell genomics technologies, we present a comprehensive single-cell transcriptomic landscape of 1499 669 cells in the lungs from birds (chickens, ducks, and pigeons) and mammals (mice and pigs) upon H5-HPAIV infection. H5-HPAIV primarily infected avian endothelial cells and mammalian epithelial cells, respectively. Among the single-cell transcriptomic lung landscape, H5-HPAIV infection induced significant inflammation in fibroblasts and the shedding of alveolar epithelial cells of chickens upon infection, while the expression levels of cytokine- and inflammation-related genes slightly decreased in fibroblasts and endothelial cells of infected ducks and pigeons, respectively. However, mice only exhibited significantly antiviral response in macrophages and neutrophils, while antiviral response was elevated in most subtype cells of pigs upon infection. Notably, we identified 19 viral non-synonymous intrahost single nucleotide variants (iSNVs) in infected birds and mammals and assessed their molecular characterizations in vitro. Three of them were identified to increase polymerase activity and viral replication in situ, among which the PB2-E627K mutation was enriched in the alveolar structure of lungs, accompanied by elevated expression of interferon-stimulated genes. Collectively, we elucidated distinct viral replication, host response, and viral adaptation in the lungs across diverse birds and mammals upon H5-HPAIV infection.

title: Ultralow-dose X-ray imaging enabled by vertically homogeneous perovskite films
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly pushing imaging and sensing toward automated, quantitative decision-making, heightening the demand for reliable low-photon-flux detection and imaging across infrared through X-ray regimes, yet developing detectors that truly operate effectively at ultralow photon fluxes has been a challenge. As a canonical instance, low-dose X-ray imaging operates under intrinsically sparse photon statistics, where Poisson fluctuations along the absorption depth couple to vertical transport non-uniformity and are statistically amplified at ultralow dose. Here we elucidate this materials-to-electronics bottleneck and develop a new liquid-phase growth and annealing (LPGA) strategy that eliminates thermal and mass-transport instabilities in conventional methods during crystallization, yielding perovskite films with exceptional vertical uniformity. This enables depth-independent charge collection, significantly reducing stochastic fluctuations in the readout and achieving a ten-fold reduction in image noise. In imaging applications, our detectors deliver high-quality X-ray imaging at an ultralow effective per-pixel integration dose of 40.6 nGyair, setting a new benchmark for safe, high-quality clinical imaging.
title_zh: 垂直均匀钙钛矿薄膜实现超低剂量 X 射线成像
abstract_zh: 人工智能 (AI) 正在迅速推动成像和传感朝着自动化、定量决策的方向发展，从而提高了对通过 X 射线范围进行红外可靠低光子通量检测和成像的需求，但开发真正在超低光子通量下有效运行的探测器一直是一项挑战。作为一个典型的例子，低剂量 X 射线成像在本质上稀疏的光子统计下运行，其中沿吸收深度的泊松波动与垂直传输不均匀性耦合，并在超低剂量下被统计放大。在这里，我们阐明了这种材料到电子器件的瓶颈，并开发了一种新的液相生长和退火（LPGA）策略，该策略消除了结晶过程中传统方法中的热和质量传输不稳定性，产生具有出色垂直均匀性的钙钛矿薄膜。这实现了与深度无关的电荷收集，显着减少了读出的随机波动，并将图像噪声降低了十倍。在成像应用中，我们的探测器以 40.6 nGyair 的超低有效每像素积分剂量提供高质量的 X 射线成像，为安全、高质量的临床成像树立了新的基准。

abstract: Cholesterol carried by low-density lipoprotein (LDL) drives heart disease and is cleared by liver cells expressing the receptor LDLR. title: Batteries versus fuel cells for decarbonizing medium- and heavy-duty vehicles across applications
source: Nature Energy
abstract: Medium- and heavy-duty vehicles are a major source of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions in the United States and globally. Batteries and fuel cells can play a critical role in decarbonizing this sector. Here we conduct a life-cycle GHG assessment of class 3–8 internal combustion engine vehicles, hybrid electric vehicles (HEVs), fuel cell electric vehicles (FCEVs) and battery electric vehicles (BEVs) in the United States. Compared with conventional diesel-fuelled options, alternative powertrains reduce emissions across vehicle types: HEVs by 1–26%, FCEVs using hydrogen produced from steam methane reforming by 12–51%, BEVs powered by the grid by 44–68%, FCEVs using hydrogen produced from electrolysis powered by renewable electricity by 72–82% and BEVs powered by renewable electricity by 87–92%. The ordering of these powertrains holds across cargo weights, drive cycles, regional electricity grids and grid projections. We also assess renewable electricity consumption and hydrogen leakage, two factors that must be considered when evaluating the suitability of different powertrains for decarbonization.

title: Ligand-enabled distal desaturative lactonization of aliphatic acids
source: Nature
abstract: Transition metal catalysis serves as a fundamental strategy for transforming inert C−H bonds into valuable functional motifs.1,2 However, achieving regioselective activation of remote C−H bonds remains challenging, particularly in unbiased hydrocarbon frameworks.2,3 In this context, distal C(sp3)−H bonds are especially difficult to functionalize, as conformational flexibility favors proximal C−H activation.3,4 In this study, we demonstrate a ligand-enabled strategy using designed O-allyl amido ester (OAAE) ligands for palladium-catalyzed activation of γ-methylene and methine C−H sites in unbiased aliphatic carboxylic acids, derived from readily available fatty and cyclic acid feedstocks. This protocol enables direct transformation of aliphatic carboxylic acid substrates into distal desaturated γ-lactones and double dehydrogenated γ-spirolactones. Mechanistic studies are consistent with a pathway involving Pd(II)-mediated γ-C(sp3)−H activation, followed by dehydrogenation and intramolecular cyclization. These lactones with an unsaturated arm, serve as key intermediates for the formation of complex natural products and pharmaceuticals. For instance, muricatacin (from soursop/laxman phal) and its analogue were rapidly assembled in three steps from margaric acid using this strategy and evaluated for anticancer activity, thereby demonstrating the potential of our approach for providing a rapid access to biologically relevant frameworks for traditional medicine. The introduced distal desaturation further opens up new avenues for remote functionalization, streamlining access to diverse bioactive molecules with improved step and atom economy.

title: Base editing reveals an essential role for NANOG in human embryogenesis
source: Nature
abstract: Understanding how the first cell lineages in human development are specified and maintained has fundamental importance and clinical implications for regenerative medicine, infertility and pregnancy loss. While mouse models have provided valuable insights into transcription factors regulating early development, translating these findings to human embryos has been limited by ethical, technical and biological constraints. Functional studies of transcription factors in human embryos have been hindered by nuclease-based genome-editing approaches that induce genotoxicity1-3. To overcome this, we applied adenine base editing (ABE8e)4,5 to precisely target an exon splice donor site, resulting in a splicing defect and functional knockout of NANOG, representing the first application of base editing to study a developmental regulator in human embryos. This approach did not trigger genotoxicity and showed limited off-target editing. Loss of NANOG disrupts pluripotent epiblast specification and instead cells differentiate toward a primitive endoderm (yolk sac) or trophectoderm (placental) transcriptional programme. Retention of primitive endoderm differentiation in NANOG-edited human embryos reveals a functional compensation distinct from mouse, underscoring the importance of directly investigating human development. Our findings demonstrate an essential role for NANOG in human pluripotency and epiblast specification, and highlight the utility of base editing for functional interrogation of human development.
title_zh: 碱基编辑揭示了 NANOG 在人类胚胎发生中的重要作用
abstract_zh: 了解人类发育中的第一个细胞谱系是如何被指定和维持的，对于再生医学、不孕症和流产具有根本重要性和临床意义。虽然小鼠模型为调控早期发育的转录因子提供了宝贵的见解，但将这些发现转化为人类胚胎却受到伦理、技术和生物学方面的限制。人类胚胎转录因子的功能研究受到基于核酸酶的基因组编辑方法的阻碍，这些方法会诱导基因毒性1-3。为了克服这个问题，我们应用腺嘌呤碱基编辑 (ABE8e)4,5 精确定位外显子剪接供体位点，导致 NANOG 的剪接缺陷和功能性敲除，这是碱基编辑首次应用于研究人类胚胎发育调节因子。这种方法不会引发遗传毒性，并且显示出有限的脱靶编辑。 NANOG 的缺失会破坏多能外胚层规范，细胞会分化为原始内胚层（卵黄囊）或滋养外胚层（胎盘）转录程序。 NANOG 编辑的人类胚胎中原始内胚层分化的保留揭示了与小鼠不同的功能补偿，强调了直接研究人类发育的重要性。我们的研究结果证明了 NANOG 在人类多能性和外胚层规范中的重要作用，并强调了碱基编辑在人类发育功能询问中的实用性。

title: Diversification of angiosperm reproductive strategies predated the end-Cretaceous extinction
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: Angiosperm reproductive evolution is traditionally linked to the end-Cretaceous biotic crisis and subsequent ecological restructuring. Here, we report diverse and unexpectedly large diaspores (dispersal units) from an in situ late Campanian (74.6 million years ago) tropical forest from the Jose Creek Formation in New Mexico. Nearly 80 distinct diaspore morphotypes demonstrate that the flora had increased morphological specialization and an exceptionally large average and range of diaspore volume comparable to the Cenozoic records. These findings suggest that substantial increases in reproductive investment and specialization preceded the end-Cretaceous extinction. Our results indicate that Cretaceous angiosperms had already evolved diverse dispersal strategies, suggesting that animal-mediated dispersal and dense, angiosperm-integrated canopies were established far earlier than was previously recognized.

title: Lariat RNA debranching prevents harmful siRNA burst in plants
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: Lariat RNAs are formed from introns during pre–messenger RNA splicing, after which they are degraded by the debranching enzyme DBR1. Impairment of DBR1 leads to developmental arrest, yet the mechanism remains unclear. In this study, we found that debranching of lariat RNA prevents production of 21- and 22-nucleotide lariat-derived small interfering RNAs (lasiRNAs), which causes a burst of exonic siRNAs, thereby safeguarding development and defense response. LasiRNA biogenesis relied on RNA-dependent RNA polymerases and Dicer-like proteins (DCLs). Upon pathogen infection and dysfunction of DBR1, many lariat RNAs were hijacked by DCL4 and DCL2 and processed into siRNAs that particularly target immunity genes, ultimately disrupting plant defense responses. Collectively, DBR1-mediated lariat RNA removal serves as a protective mechanism to prevent the activation of a small RNA–based defense system in plants.

title: Nano–electron volt Fourier-limited transition of a single surface-adsorbed molecule
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: High-resolution spectroscopy allows the probing of weak interactions and subtle phenomena. Although such measurements are routinely performed in the gas phase and in crystalline materials, studies of adsorbed species on surfaces have previously fallen short of the ultimate spectral resolution, where dephasing is eliminated and the transition linewidth is determined by the excited-state lifetime. In this work, we devise an approach to surface preparation and deposition that provides access to Fourier-limited electronic transitions in single molecules on the surface of an organic crystal. By performing spectroscopy and super-resolution microscopy at liquid helium temperature, we shed light on the spectral and spatial features of the adsorbed species. Our results pave the way for investigations in solid-state physics, where angstrom spatial resolution can be combined with high-resolution laser spectroscopy.
title_zh: 单个表面吸附分子的纳电子伏傅里叶极限跃迁
abstract_zh: 高分辨率光谱可以探测弱相互作用和微妙的现象。尽管此类测量通常在气相和晶体材料中进行，但之前对表面吸附物质的研究未能达到最终的光谱分辨率，其中消除了相移，并且跃迁线宽由激发态寿命决定。在这项工作中，我们设计了一种表面准备和沉积方法，可以获取有机晶体表面单分子中的傅里叶限制电子跃迁。通过在液氦温度下进行光谱和超分辨率显微镜，我们揭示了吸附物质的光谱和空间特征。我们的结果为固态物理学的研究铺平了道路，其中埃空间分辨率可以与高分辨率激光光谱相结合。

title: Reversible suppression of autophagy in a mouse model reveals neuronal resilience
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: Impairments in intracellular quality-control mechanisms, including autophagy, affect neuronal integrity and function. Despite numerous studies aimed at slowing neuronal deterioration, it remains unclear whether neuronal function and intracellular quality can be restored once impaired. We developed a mouse model in which autophagy could be rapidly and reversibly regulated to investigate the reversibility of such defects. Suppressing autophagy led to proteome and transcriptome changes, inclusion body accumulation, and axonal swelling, all of which were largely ameliorated after autophagy restoration. Consistent with these cellular abnormalities, autophagy suppression induced motor and cognitive dysfunction, which was also reversed on autophagy restoration. Our findings elucidate the potential resilience of neuronal function and quality enabled by intracellular clearance.
title_zh: 小鼠模型中自噬的可逆抑制揭示了神经元的弹性
abstract_zh: 细胞内质量控制机制（包括自噬）的损伤会影响神经元的完整性和功能。尽管有大量研究旨在减缓神经元退化，但仍不清楚神经元功能和细胞内质量一旦受损是否可以恢复。我们开发了一种可以快速、可逆地调节自噬的小鼠模型，以研究此类缺陷的可逆性。抑制自噬导致蛋白质组和转录组变化、包涵体积累和轴突肿胀，所有这些在自噬恢复后都得到了很大程度的改善。与这些细胞异常一致，自噬抑制引起运动和认知功能障碍，这在自噬恢复时也被逆转。我们的研究结果阐明了细胞内清除所带来的神经元功能和质量的潜在弹性。

title: Impact heating and the hidden Hadean
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: The nature of Earth’s crust during the Hadean eon [≥4.03 billion years ago (Ga)] is uncertain. Numerical models of early Earth geodynamics emphasize the control of mantle temperature but generally consider only internally derived heat, despite empirical evidence for an intense Hadean impact flux. Using a stochastic model of that flux, we show that the time-integrated heat due to impacts would have dwarfed that produced internally throughout the Hadean. Earth’s Hadean crust would have been extensively molten at depths below a few kilometers, causing gravitational segregation of dense, iron- and magnesium-rich material and driving average crustal compositions to become increasingly silica rich. Globally, impact heating would have become much less important after 3.9 Ga, allowing the crust to thicken. That enduring continental crust appeared around this time is likely not a coincidence.
title_zh: 冲击加热和隐藏的冥古宙
abstract_zh: 冥古宙[≥40.3亿年前（Ga）]期间地壳的性质尚不确定。早期地球动力学的数值模型强调地幔温度的控制，但通常只考虑内部产生的热量，尽管经验证据表明存在强烈的冥宙冲击通量。使用该通量的随机模型，我们表明，由于撞击而产生的时间积分热量将使整个冥古宙内部产生的热量相形见绌。地球的冥古宙地壳在几公里以下的深度可能已经广泛熔化，导致致密、富含铁和镁的物质发生重力偏析，并导致平均地壳成分变得越来越富含二氧化硅。从全球范围来看，3.9 Ga 之后，撞击加热将变得不那么重要，从而使地壳变厚。大约在这个时候出现的持久大陆地壳很可能不是巧合。

title: Illuminating the molecular basis of human daylight vision
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: Photopic vision, including fast motion and color perception in daylight, is mediated by cone opsins, specialized G protein–coupled receptors (GPCRs). Despite sharing the same chromophore, the three receptor subtypes absorb light at different wavelengths of the visible spectrum. The molecular mechanisms governing their spectral properties and exceptionally rapid responses remain largely unknown. We report cryo–electron microscopy structures of the human blue-sensitive (OPN1SW) and green-sensitive (OPN1MW) cone opsins in their dark-adapted states, combined with femtosecond-resolution spectroscopy, functional assays, and advanced simulations. The data reveal distinct chromophore stabilization mechanisms across human visual opsins and specific sequence adaptations in the GPCR microswitch motifs, underlining their structural plasticity and distinct activation mechanisms. These findings delineate the molecular basis of the evolutionary refinements fulfilling the needs of vision in daylight.
title_zh: 阐明人类日光视觉的分子基础
abstract_zh: 明视觉，包括日光下的快速运动和颜色感知，是由视锥蛋白、特殊的 G 蛋白偶联受体 (GPCR) 介导的。尽管共享相同的发色团，但这三种受体亚型吸收可见光谱不同波长的光。控制其光谱特性和异常快速响应的分子机制仍然很大程度上未知。我们报告了人类蓝敏感 (OPN1SW) 和绿敏感 (OPN1MW) 锥体视蛋白在暗适应状态下的冷冻电子显微镜结构，并结合飞秒分辨率光谱、功能测定和高级模拟。这些数据揭示了人类视觉视蛋白中不同的发色团稳定机制以及 GPCR 微开关基序中的特定序列适应，强调了它们的结构可塑性和独特的激活机制。这些发现描绘了满足日光视觉需求的进化改进的分子基础。

title: Structural N- and O-glycans revealed by high-resolution cryo-EM analysis of tubular mastigonemes
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract:
The chemical complexity and nontemplated biosynthesis of glycans have posed considerable challenges for establishing sequence-structure relationships. Here we report cryo–electron microscopy structures of tubular mastigonemes from a golden alga species,
                    Ochromonas danica
                    , in which a large number of N- and O-glycans are resolved at 1.8- to 2.2-angstrom resolution. Beyond high-mannose and complex N-glycans, we identify a noncanonical N-glycan on the Ala-Asn-Asp (AND) motif. The surface spikes comprise dense O-glycans coating PSXX tetrapeptide repeats, with two glycans linked on trihydroxylated proline and one on serine per repeat. In addition to various types of sugars and their covalent modifiers, water molecules (>10% of resolved volume) and cations are clearly resolved and mediate the structural assembly. Our study establishes a framework for investigating glycan folding in high-order biological assemblies.
title_zh: 通过管状鞭毛体的高分辨率冷冻电镜分析揭示结构 N- 和 O-聚糖
abstract_zh:
聚糖的化学复杂性和非模板生物合成对建立序列-结构关系提出了相当大的挑战。在这里，我们报告了来自金藻物种的管状鞭毛体的冷冻电子显微镜结构，
                    丹麦红单胞菌
                    ，其中大量 N- 和 O- 聚糖以 1.8 至 2.2 埃的分辨率进行解析。除了高甘露糖和复杂的 N-聚糖之外，我们还在 Ala-Asn-Asp (AND) 基序上鉴定出一种非规范的 N-聚糖。表面刺突包含密集的 O-聚糖涂层 PSXX 四肽重复序列，每个重复序列有两个聚糖连接在三羟基脯氨酸上，一个聚糖连接在丝氨酸上。除了各种类型的糖及其共价修饰剂之外，水分子（> 解析体积的 10%）和阳离子也被清晰地解析并介导结构组装。我们的研究建立了一个研究高阶生物组装中聚糖折叠的框架。

title: Iron-catalyzed active lipid peroxides drive ultrafast collective cell death in blooming algae
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract:
Harmful algal blooms, the most severe ecological hazards worldwide, terminate abruptly within a few days. In this work, we identified that iron-catalyzed active lipid peroxides predominantly trigger individual cell ferroptosis and drive the population collapse of blooming cyanobacteria. We reveal the chronological sequence of labile iron burst, oxidative stress, lipid peroxidation, and cell death during a
                    Microcystis
                    bloom demise event. Dead cells exhibit a nonrandom spatial distribution within colonies. Intensifying lipid peroxidation catalyzed by cellular labile iron generates truncated phospholipids with shortened fatty acyl chains bearing alkyl groups. These active lipid peroxides destabilize plasma membranes and induce nanoscale membrane pore formation, resulting in individual cell ferroptosis and lysis. Oxidized lipids are also released from ferroptotic cells, propagating lipid peroxidation to neighboring cells, thereby spreading death throughout the population.
title_zh: 铁催化的活性脂质过氧化物驱动开花藻类的超快集体细胞死亡
abstract_zh:
有害藻华是全球最严重的生态危害，几天之内就会突然终止。在这项工作中，我们发现铁催化的活性脂质过氧化物主要引发单个细胞铁死亡并导致大量蓝细菌的种群崩溃。我们揭示了不稳定铁爆发、氧化应激、脂质过氧化和细胞死亡的时间顺序
                    微囊藻属
                    绽放消亡事件。死细胞在集落内表现出非随机的空间分布。由细胞不稳定铁催化的强化脂质过氧化作用产生截短的磷脂，其具有带有烷基的缩短的脂肪酰基链。这些活性脂质过氧化物使质膜不稳定并诱导纳米级膜孔形成，导致单个细胞铁死亡和裂解。铁死亡细胞也会释放氧化脂质，将脂质过氧化传播到邻近细胞，从而在整个群体中传播死亡。

title: Ubiquitin-like proteins NEDD8 and SUMO2 control epithelial homeostasis, regeneration, and inflammation
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: Stratified epithelial differentiation involves transcriptional and proteomic remodeling. Here, multiomic profiling implicated ubiquitin and related posttranslational networks in differentiation dynamics. Systematic perturbation of ubiquitin-like machinery in primary human keratinocytes which uncovered opposite functions of neural-precursor-cell–expressed, developmentally down-regulated 8 (NEDD8) and small ubiquitin-related modifier 2 (SUMO2). Generation of conditional knockout mice established essential roles for NEDD8 in progenitor maintenance, skin regeneration, and inflammation, whereas SUMO2 was required for differentiation. Beyond ubiquitin-proteasome-concordant changes, NEDD8 directed proteomic regulation correlated with RNA abundance. Integration of immunoprecipitation– mass spectrometry with genome-wide suppressor screening revealed context-specific NEDDylation dependencies. Among effectors, heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein U (HNRNPU) emerged as a posttranscriptional regulator of epithelial cell state whose RNA binding repertoire was modulated by NEDDylation. Thus, NEDD8 and SUMO2 play opposite roles in epithelial homeostasis, regeneration, and inflammation, demonstrating multiple ways ubiquitin-like networks govern tissue homeostasis.
title_zh: 泛素样蛋白 NEDD8 和 SUMO2 控制上皮稳态、再生和炎症
abstract_zh: 分层上皮分化涉及转录和蛋白质组重塑。在这里，多组学分析表明泛素和相关的翻译后网络参与分化动态。对原代人角质形成细胞中泛素样机制的系统性扰动，揭示了神经前体细胞表达的发育下调 8 (NEDD8) 和小泛素相关修饰物 2 (SUMO2) 的相反功能。条件敲除小鼠的产生确立了 NEDD8 在祖细胞维持、皮肤再生和炎症中的重要作用，而 SUMO2 是分化所必需的。除了泛素-蛋白酶体一致的变化之外，NEDD8 还指导与 RNA 丰度相关的蛋白质组调控。免疫沉淀-质谱与全基因组抑制筛选的整合揭示了上下文特异性的 NEDDylation 依赖性。在效应子中，异质核核糖核蛋白 U (HNRNPU) 作为上皮细胞状态的转录后调节因子出现，其 RNA 结合库受到 NEDDylation 的调节。因此，NEDD8 和 SUMO2 在上皮稳态、再生和炎症中发挥相反的作用，证明了泛素样网络控制组织稳态的多种方式。

title: Cryo–electron microscopy structures of human cone visual pigments
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract:
Human trichromatic color vision relies on three cone opsins [long-, middle-, and short-wavelength-sensitive opsins (LWS-, MWS-, and SWS-opsins, respectively)], whereas scotopic rod vision is mediated by rhodopsin. Although the structure of rhodopsin was solved more than 20 years ago, cone opsin structures have been lacking. Here, we present cryo–electron microscopy structures of the three human cone opsins, each bound to a G protein and all-
                    trans
                    retinal in the presumed active state. All three cone opsins differ markedly from rhodopsin. Within the retinal binding pocket, we identified a distinct counterion site (LWS- and MWS-opsins) and a ring of serines around the retinal (SWS-opsin). The active cone opsin structures explain how amino acid substitutions fine-tune spectral sensitivity and help clarify the molecular basis of color vision deficiencies and key differences in rod versus cone activation.
title_zh: 人类视锥细胞视色素的冷冻电子显微镜结构
abstract_zh:
人类三色视觉依赖于三种视锥细胞视蛋白[长波、中波和短波敏感视蛋白（分别为LWS-、MWS-和SWS-视蛋白）]，而暗视杆视觉则由视紫红质介导。尽管视紫红质的结构在20多年前就已被解决，但视锥细胞视蛋白的结构一直缺乏。在这里，我们展示了三种人类视锥细胞视蛋白的冷冻电子显微镜结构，每种视蛋白都与 G 蛋白结合，并且全部-
                    反式
                    视网膜处于假定的活跃状态。所有三种视锥细胞视蛋白都与视紫红质显着不同。在视网膜结合袋内，我们确定了一个独特的抗衡离子位点（LWS-和MWS-视蛋白）和视网膜周围的丝氨酸环（SWS-视蛋白）。活性视锥细胞视蛋白结构解释了氨基酸取代如何微调光谱灵敏度，并有助于阐明色觉缺陷的分子基础以及视杆细胞与视锥细胞激活的关键差异。

title: Structural insights into spectral tuning and retinal exchange in cone visual pigments
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract:
Color vision in catarrhine primates relies on red-, green-, and blue-sensitive cone pigments that share an 11-
                    cis
                    -retinal chromophore but differ in absorption maxima. Red and green pigments arose by recent gene duplication and differ at only a few residues. Here, we report cryo–electron microscopy structures of red and green cone pigments from the cynomolgus macaque (
                    Macaca fascicularis
                    ) integrated with low-temperature vibrational spectroscopy and quantum mechanical and molecular mechanical modeling. The red-green spectral shift is dominated by threonine 285, the hydroxyl dipole of which modulates chromophore electrostatics, whereas steric effects appear modest. We also identified membrane-facing lateral openings in cone pigments but not in inactive rhodopsin. Comparisons with active-state structures suggest activation-dependent gating, and mutational and spectroscopic analyses support a role for this opening in retinal uptake and rapid pigment regeneration.
title_zh: 锥视色素光谱调谐和视网膜交换的结构见解
abstract_zh:
卡他灵长类动物的色觉依赖于对红色、绿色和蓝色敏感的视锥色素，它们共享 11-

                    食蟹猴

title: On the origin of PRDM9-guided recombination hotspots
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Meiotic recombination is highly conserved across vertebrates and plays an essential role in ensuring chromosomal segmentation and generating genomic variation. However, species employ two strikingly different mechanisms to guide recombination. In most mammals, recombination hotspot locations are determined by the protein PRDM9, which binds specific DNA sequence motifs. These motifs are rapidly eroded by biased gene conversion, rendering this mechanism self-destructive and evolutionarily transient. In contrast, birds initiate recombination at open chromatin regions independently of sequence motifs, producing self-preserving and evolutionarily stable recombination hotspots. Some species use both types of hotspots simultaneously, raising the unresolved question of why PRDM9-guided hotspots persist alongside a robust alternative. Here, we address this problem using a population genetic model that explicitly considers competition between PRDM9-guided and non-PRDM9-guided recombination hotspots. We show that non-PRDM9-guided hotspots are generally favored because, lacking sequence specificity, they generate more crossovers required for proper chromosome segregation. However, PRDM9-guided hotspots can overcome this disadvantage when simultaneous binding of both homologous chromosomes (symmetric binding) is more likely to resolve as crossovers than binding of a single homolog (asymmetric binding). Although PRDM9 reduces overall crossover rate, its sequence specificity increases the probability of symmetric binding within hotspots, creating a trade-off that can favor PRDM9 under specific selection regimes. Our model predicts that PRDM9-dependent species are particularly sensitive to disruptions of symmetric binding, whereas species lacking PRDM9 are more vulnerable to complete crossover failure. Intermediate regimes allow stable coexistence of both hotspot types.
title_zh: PRDM9引导重组热点的起源
abstract_zh: 减数分裂重组在脊椎动物中高度保守，在确保染色体分割和产生基因组变异方面发挥着重要作用。然而，物种采用两种截然不同的机制来引导重组。在大多数哺乳动物中，重组热点位置由蛋白质 PRDM9 决定，该蛋白质结合特定的 DNA 序列基序。这些基序会被有偏见的基因转换迅速侵蚀，使这种机制具有自我毁灭性和进化短暂性。相比之下，鸟类在独立于序列基序的开放染色质区域启动重组，产生自我保护和进化稳定的重组热点。有些物种同时使用两种类型的热点，这就提出了一个尚未解决的问题：为什么 PRDM9 引导的热点与强大的替代方案一起存在。在这里，我们使用群体遗传模型来解决这个问题，该模型明确考虑了 PRDM9 引导和非 PRDM9 引导的重组热点之间的竞争。我们表明，非 PRDM9 引导的热点通常受到青睐，因为缺乏序列特异性，它们会产生正确染色体分离所需的更多交叉。然而，当两个同源染色体的同时结合（对称结合）比单个同源染色体的结合（不对称结合）更有可能解析为交叉时，PRDM9引导的热点可以克服这个缺点。尽管 PRDM9 降低了总体交叉率，但其序列特异性增加了热点内对称结合的概率，从而产生了一种在特定条件下有利于 PRDM9 的权衡。

title: Exploring memory effects: Sparse identification in vector-borne diseases
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Predicting the human burden of vector-borne diseases from limited surveillance data remains a major challenge, particularly in the presence of nonlinear transmission dynamics and delayed effects arising from vector ecology and human behavior. We develop a data-driven framework based on an extension of Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics to systems with distributed memory, enabling discovery of transmission mechanisms directly from time series data. Using severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome as a case study, we show that this approach can uncover key features of tick-borne disease dynamics using only human incidence and local temperature data, without imposing predefined assumptions on human case reporting. We further ascertain the robustness of the recovered incidence-temperature model by integrating it with mechanistically derived tick–host covariates, showing that the forecasting ability does not improve. This suggests that the proposed core data-driven model already delivers strong predictions. The framework also allows for systematic sensitivity analysis of memory kernels and behavioral parameters. Although the approach prioritizes predictive accuracy over mechanistic transparency, it yields sparse, interpretable integral representations suitable for epidemiological forecasting. This methodology provides a scalable strategy for forecasting vector-borne disease risk and informing public health decision-making under data limitations.
title_zh: 探索记忆效应：媒介传播疾病的稀疏识别
abstract_zh: 根据有限的监测数据预测媒介传播疾病对人类的负担仍然是一项重大挑战，特别是在存在非线性传播动力学以及媒介生态和人类行为引起的延迟效应的情况下。我们开发了一个数据驱动框架，该框架基于将非线性动力学稀疏识别扩展到具有分布式内存的系统，从而能够直接从时间序列数据中发现传输机制。以严重发烧伴血小板减少综合征为案例研究，我们表明，这种方法可以仅使用人类发病率和当地温度数据来揭示蜱传疾病动态的关键特征，而无需对人类病例报告强加预定义的假设。我们通过将恢复的发病温度模型与机械推导的蜱宿主协变量相结合，进一步确定了恢复的发病温度模型的稳健性，表明预测能力没有提高。这表明所提出的核心数据驱动模型已经提供了强有力的预测。该框架还允许对内存内核和行为参数进行系统的敏感性分析。尽管该方法优先考虑预测准确性而不是机械透明度，但它产生了适合流行病学预测的稀疏、可解释的积分表示。该方法提供了一种可扩展的策略，用于预测媒介传播疾病风险并为数据限制下的公共卫生决策提供信息。

title: Single-cell multiomics of neuron activation reveals context-specific genetics of brain disorders
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: Most causal variants for neuropsychiatric disorders (NPD) remain unknown. A major hurdle is that disease variants may act in specific contexts, such as during neuronal activation, which is difficult to study in vivo at the population level. We profiled single-nucleus neuron-activation multiomics in human induced pluripotent stem cell–derived neurons from 100 donors, revealing the NPD-relevant transcriptomic and epigenomic landscape of neuronal activation. We identified abundant genetic variants associated with activity-dependent gene expression and chromatin accessibility, the latter explaining larger proportions of NPD heritability. Integrating multiomics data with genome-wide association studies further revealed NPD risk variants and genes with effects detected only upon stimulation, such as activity-dependent cholesterol metabolism. Our work highlights the power of cell stimulation to reveal context-specific “hidden” genetic effects.
title_zh: 神经元激活的单细胞多组学揭示了脑部疾病的背景特异性遗传学
abstract_zh: 神经精神疾病 (NPD) 的大多数致病变异仍然未知。一个主要障碍是疾病变异可能在特定情况下起作用，例如在神经元激活期间，这很难在群体水平上进行体内研究。我们对来自 100 个供体的人类诱导多能干细胞衍生神经元的单核神经元激活多组学进行了分析，揭示了神经元激活的 NPD 相关转录组和表观基因组景观。我们发现了与活性依赖性基因表达和染色质可及性相关的丰富遗传变异，后者解释了较大比例的 NPD 遗传力。将多组学数据与全基因组关联研究相结合，进一步揭示了 NPD 风险变异和仅在刺激时才检测到影响的基因，例如活动依赖性胆固醇代谢。我们的工作强调了细胞刺激揭示特定环境“隐藏”遗传效应的力量。

title: HDAC inhibition sensitizes pancreatic tumors to DNA damage by global redistribution of the transcriptional machinery
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: The DNA damage response (DDR) is critical for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) development and therapeutic responses, including to genotoxic agents. While epigenetic modulators have been shown to contribute to the DDR, how chromatin regulation dictates responses to DNA damage in PDAC remains incompletely understood. Here, we identify Class I histone deacetylases (HDACs) as critical regulators of the DDR. HDAC1/2 direct the genomic distribution of H3K27ac, ensuring sufficient BRD4 and RNA polymerase II (Pol II) occupancy at DDR gene promoters. HDAC inhibition by entinostat shifts the balance of H3K27 acetylation preferentially toward intergenic regions, diverting BRD4 and Pol II from promoters, thereby suppressing DDR gene expression. In line with this, HDAC inhibition heightens DNA damage and sensitizes PDAC to diverse DNA-damaging and DDR-targeting agents. Since the clinical development of HDAC inhibitors has been limited by systemic toxicity, we developed bottlebrush prodrug (BPD) nanoparticles for tumor-selective entinostat delivery. Entinostat-BPD achieved tumor-specific HDAC inhibition while displaying potent efficacy and reduced systemic toxicity. These findings reveal an HDAC-dependent DDR vulnerability and offer combinational and precision targeting strategies to facilitate clinical translation and improve PDAC patient outcomes.
title_zh: HDAC 抑制通过转录机制的整体重新分布使胰腺肿瘤对 DNA 损伤敏感
abstract_zh: DNA 损伤反应 (DDR) 对于胰腺导管腺癌 (PDAC) 的发展和治疗反应（包括对基因毒性药物的反应）至关重要。虽然表观遗传调节剂已被证明有助于 DDR，但染色质调控如何决定 PDAC 中 DNA 损伤的反应仍不完全清楚。在这里，我们将 I 类组蛋白脱乙酰酶 (HDAC) 确定为 DDR 的关键调节因子。 HDAC1/2 指导 H3K27ac 的基因组分布，确保 DDR 基因启动子上有足够的 BRD4 和 RNA 聚合酶 II (Pol II) 占据。恩替司他抑制 HDAC 会优先将 H3K27 乙酰化的平衡转向基因间区域，将 BRD4 和 Pol II 从启动子转移，从而抑制 DDR 基因表达。与此相一致的是，HDAC 抑制会加剧 DNA 损伤，并使 PDAC 对多种 DNA 损伤剂和 DDR 靶向剂敏感。由于 HDAC 抑制剂的临床开发受到全身毒性的限制，我们开发了用于肿瘤选择性恩替司他递送的瓶刷前药 (BPD) 纳米颗粒。 Entinostat-BPD 实现了肿瘤特异性 HDAC 抑制，同时显示出有效的功效并降低了全身毒性。这些发现揭示了 HDAC 依赖性 DDR 的脆弱性，并提供了组合和精确的靶向策略，以促进临床转化并改善 PDAC 患者的治疗结果。

title: Large cities lose their growth advantage as countries urbanize
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: The share of the world population living in cities with more than one million people rose from 11% in 1975 to 24% in 2025 (our estimates). Will this trend toward greater concentration in large cities continue or level off? We introduce two new city population datasets that use consistent city definitions across countries and over time. The first covers the world between 1975 and 2025, using satellite imagery. The second covers the United States between 1850 and 2020, using census microdata. We find that urban growth follows a characteristic life cycle. In the early stages of a country’s urbanization process, large cities grow faster than smaller ones. At later stages, growth rates equalize across sizes. We use this life cycle to project future population concentration in large cities. Our projections suggest that 38% of the world population will be living in cities with more than one million people by 2100. This estimate is higher than the 33% implied by the well-known theory of proportional growth, but lower than the 42% obtained by extrapolating current trends.
title_zh: 随着国家城市化，大城市失去增长优势
abstract_zh: 居住在人口超过 100 万的城市的世界人口比例从 1975 年的 11% 上升到 2025 年的 24%（我们的估计）。这种向大城市集中的趋势会持续还是趋于平稳？我们引入了两个新的城市人口数据集，它们在不同国家和不同时期使用一致的城市定义。第一个使用卫星图像覆盖 1975 年至 2025 年间的世界。第二个涵盖 1850 年至 2020 年间的美国，使用人口普查微观数据。我们发现城市增长遵循特定的生命周期。在一个国家城市化进程的早期阶段，大城市的发展速度快于小城市。在后期阶段，不同规模的增长率趋于平衡。我们利用这个生命周期来预测大城市未来的人口集中度。我们的预测表明，到 2100 年，世界人口的 38% 将居住在人口超过 100 万的城市。这一估计高于著名的比例增长理论所暗示的 33%，但低于根据当前趋势推断得出的 42%。

title: Antibiotics stimulate protein transfer to persister cells
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract:
The exchange of biological matter between bacterial cells drives adaptation and evolution. However, whether bacteria can exchange functional proteins remains unclear. In this work, we found that antibiotic treatment can induce vesicle-mediated horizontal protein transfer within and between bacterial species. We developed a genetic system in
                    Escherichia coli
                    to track transfer events and performed single-cell transcriptomic profiling on an isogenic population of bacteria. Antibiotics stimulated the differentiation of this isogenic population into distinct cell states: donor cells that activated a membrane stress response to release protein-containing vesicles and recipient cells that suppressed this response to acquire protein from their neighbors. Protein uptake enhanced the antibiotic persistence of recipient cells, revealing that vesicle exchange promotes bacterial survival during antibiotic treatment.
